works.body:
Hi sensei! I love your work! May I request me and my friends characters?

Piper (186cm)
Piper is a playful and manipulative witch. Piper has a mole under each eye. They love humans and like causing trouble to people for fun. Please note he has an androgynous appearance, TAN skin (HEX:#d5b094), and golden spiral eyes with no shine.
Aegis (177cm)
Aegis is a blunt, relaxed, and sadistic person/werewolf. They also enjoy making trouble for fun, but they are very cunning, somewhat wild. They have freckles and scars and DARK skin (HEX: #a37458), please refer to the image labelled AEGIS-1 for scars and freckle placement.

Their relationship is violent 🔪 but fun! Piper enjoys antagonizing Aegis and Aegis has a love/hate relationship with Piper. Both enjoy fighting and consuming one another ! 🥩

Thank you for your consideration, please draw freely!
